title: G099--Health Care for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) Medical Respite  Contracted Emergency Residential Services (CERS) in Oahu,  Hawaii for VA Pacific Islands Health Care System (VAPIHCS).
agency_path: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.261-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 21 (36C261)
detail_text: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office (NCO) 21, plans to issue a Request for Quote (RFQ) for Health Care for Homeless Veterans (HCHV) Medical Respite Contracted Emergency Residential Services (CERS) in Oahu, Hawaii for VA Pacific Islands Health Care System (VAPIHCS) in accordance with the performance work statement contained herein. The solicitation number for this RFQ is 36C26126Q0647. The solicitation will be issued on or about May 04, 2026, with an anticipated due date of June 02, 2026. The North American Industry Classification Systems (NAICS) is 624221, size standard $13.5M. Contractors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov. Please send any questions or inquires to Lacy.Morgan@va.gov.
